summary:
Main
Today's iron ore market performance on the Dalian Commodity Exchange (DCE) remained weak. The DCE benchmark contract I2609 closedat 698 yuan/ton, down 2.85% from the previous trading session. Qingdao port spot prices fell by 9-12 yuan/ton from the previous day.
